name: @game1/lodelings
description: Lodelings: an idle mining RPG. Dig through the Deep, hatch crystal creatures and beat the Guardians.

scripts.build:single: vite build --mode single && tsx ../../tools/inline-html.ts dist-single dist-single/lodelings.html --title "Lodelings Test Build"

scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && tsx ../../tools/gradlew.ts android bundleRelease
